abstract.p: We map bounded spin-wave bands in one synthetic lattice.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: In the frustrated magnetism flat magnon band model, line graph flat band localization confines a magnon eigenvector to one loop because alternating spin-wave amplitudes cancel every escape path across the bounded coupling sweep.
Removing one line-graph bond releases the localized magnon mode, while restoring the closed connectivity recovers the same narrow branch and its loop-confined amplitude pattern.
